title: Alpha-compact class core with representatives of P
statement: For an essentially v-small class P in the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category, there are an object property S and a regular cardinal alpha in universe v such that S is exactly the alpha-presentable objects, S is essentially v-small, replete and triangulated, is closed under coproducts indexed by types of cardinality less than alpha, every object of S is alpha-presentable, and every object of P is alpha-presentable.

source.place: Ambient well-generation and common cardinal bound: Neeman Theorem 0.2; Krause Localization theory Sections 6.2--6.3.

proof.text: Choose a regular cardinal above the well-generation bound and above compactness ranks of representatives of P. Let S be the alpha-compact objects. Well-generation and localization give essential smallness, repleteness, triangulated closure, and closure under coproducts of fewer than alpha summands; alpha-presentability is the defining property, and the cardinal bound makes every member of P alpha-presentable.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_exists_alphaCompactClass_core
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{v} A]
    (P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory A))
    [ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{v} P] :
    ∃ (S : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory A)) (α : Cardinal.{v})
      (_ : Fact α.IsRegular),
      (∀ U, S U ↔ IsCardinalPresentable U α) ∧
      ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{v} S ∧ S.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧
      S.IsTriangulated ∧
      (∀ (I : Type v) (Y : I → DerivedCategory A),
        HasCardinalLT I α → (∀ i, S (Y i)) → S (∐ Y)) ∧
      (∀ U, S U → IsCardinalPresentable U α) ∧
      (∀ U, P U → IsCardinalPresentable U α)
